name: dsh-collaboration-access
transport: Bounded JSON-RPC NDJSON over member-owned strict SSH and server-local socket
compatibility: Exact collaborationProtocolVersion 3; no downgrade to SSH-only business access
transportIdentity: collaboration/connect is connector-only; verified SSH account is not sufficient business authorization

login.initialize: authMethods includes dingtalk-device; client verifies trusted loginOrigin
login.browser: Server-owned HTTPS OAuth page/callback; bound browser cookie, state and one-use authorization code; no service token in browser
login.claimResult: pending or one-use authenticated result including service login token; only original SSH account/device can claim
login.collaboration/login/logout: Revoke current connection login or explicit matching token/deviceId on same SSH account after disconnect; not global member qualification
login.limits: Device maximum 12 hours, organization verification maximum 5 minutes; expired verification fails closed
login.tokenStorage: Client local Host memory only; server stores token hash, no chat/browser storage

projectScopes.scope: Immutable account/project/channel context, recorded participation revision and test epoch
projectScopes.session/load: Same owner and valid scope only; qualification changes cannot revive old model context
projectScopes.session/resume: Same validation as load; never replays prompts
projectScopes.session/list: Account-owned entries with projectId; legacy unscoped entries remain history-only
projectScopes.collaboration/history: Owner and device authenticated; scoped history rechecks project qualification; legacy unscoped history is read-only
projectScopes.tools: Project ID plus all related object ownership checked; source-specific allowlist enforced server-side

requests.deduplication: Stable request ID; attempted submissions never automatically replay
requests.session/cancel: Only current owned active session, committed facts remain

communications.visibility: Enabled project participant only; private requests limited to sender/recipient; all group audience members verified before each send
communications.replyDestination: Original request records exact reply target and revision; changed/missing target means recorded-not-sent, never alternate delivery
communications.reliability: Durable inbox before ACK; durable intent and per-part state; unknown/partial never blindly replayed
communications.receipts: processQueryKey is provider correlation only, not message ID/delivery/read; explicit receipt is not formal agreement
communications.bodyRetention: Explicit administrator purge of expired database bodies; model transcript policy pending human confirmation

attachmentExtension.scope: Current human account/session/request handle, authenticated conversation project must match
attachmentExtension.reverseMethod: collaboration/attachment/read; no filesystem, terminal or other reverse methods
attachmentExtension.limits: 5 files, 20MiB per message, 49152 byte chunks; existing integrity and human archive permission rules remain
attachmentExtension.availability: DSH entry only; no IM file capability
